name: Car wash and detailing

problems.words: A car gets scratched and the customer says we did it
quick_ideas: Photograph every car before work starts, so its condition is on record
Point out existing marks to the customer at drop-off, so it's agreed upfront.

workzap_build.text: before-and-after photos per car saved against each job with time stamp, at every site and van.

problems.free_stops: The photo routine and storage are in the solution document.

problems.words: Basement washers mark cars done that weren't washed
quick_ideas: Ask for a photo of each finished car instead of a tick, so there's proof of work
Spot-check a few cars each week, so the team knows proof matters.

workzap_build.text: a job list per washer with photo proof of each car, location and time, summarised for the owner each morning.

problems.ask_first: How does a washer show today that a car was done?
problems.free_stops: How the job list and proof are set up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Subscription customers say they didn't get their washes
quick_ideas: Record each wash against the customer's package, so there's a count to share
Send customers their monthly count, with their permission, so questions are answered before complaints.

workzap_build.text: a subscription record of washes used, renewal date and payment status, with automatic monthly summaries.

problems.free_stops: Package tracking and summary timing are in the solution document.

problems.words: Monthly package payments come late or not at all
quick_ideas: List who has paid this month and who hasn't, so you know the gap
Remind late payers once, so it's raised early.

workzap_build.text: package payment tracking with automatic reminders and receipts.

problems.free_stops: Reminder steps are in the solution document.

problems.words: Weekend queues are so long people drive away
quick_ideas: Count how many cars leave without being served on a busy day, so you see the size of it
Offer regular customers a booked slot, so walk-ins spread out.

workzap_build.text: WhatsApp booking with time slots per service and bay, confirmations and reminders.

problems.free_stops: Slot rules per service are in the solution document.

problems.words: Bookings come on WhatsApp, Instagram and calls and get mixed up
quick_ideas: Put every booking into one diary, whatever the channel, so there's one list
Give one person the job of confirming bookings, so nothing is assumed.

workzap_build.text: one place where bookings from every channel land, confirmed and reminded automatically.

problems.free_stops: Channel set-up and confirmation flow are in the solution document.

problems.words: Shampoo, wax and cloth usage keeps going up
quick_ideas: Issue consumables from one store, so you know what goes out
Compare what was used against cars washed this week, so you get a first picture.

workzap_build.text: a consumables issue log with usage per car and alerts on unusual use.

problems.free_stops: How usage is measured per service is in the solution document.

problems.words: Walk-in cash doesn't match the car count
quick_ideas: Give a numbered token or slip for every car, so cars can be counted
Count cash against slips at closing, so gaps show the same day.

workzap_build.text: a daily cash-up matched to cars washed per site.

problems.free_stops: The cash-up steps are in the solution document.

problems.words: Each washer does it his own way
quick_ideas: Agree what "done" means for each service level, so everyone works to one standard
Show it to new washers on day one, so training is consistent.

workzap_build.text: service checklists on phone per wash level, ticked by the washer, with quality visible by site.

problems.free_stops: The checklists themselves are in the solution document.

problems.words: Coating customers don't come back for maintenance
quick_ideas: Tell each coating customer when maintenance is due, so they leave with a date
Ask permission to remind them, so you can follow up.

workzap_build.text: automatic maintenance reminders for ceramic and PPF customers.

problems.free_stops: Reminder timing is in the solution document.

never_say: Advice on water discharge, chemical storage or environmental permits.
Who is liable for damage, or insurance advice.
Anything on workers' visas, housing, wages or hours; refer to a lawyer or labour adviser.
Covert tracking of workers; field proof is about the job, not the person.
Storing building access codes, parking details or addresses.
Typical pricing for coatings or packages.

sample_reply.person: We do basement washes across several buildings in Dubai. Customers say their car wasn't washed and my guys say it was. What can I do?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be sorted, and you can start this week. 1) Ask for a photo of each finished car instead of a tick, so there's proof of work. 2) Spot-check a few cars yourself each week, so the team knows the proof matters. Workzap can do this automatically for you: a job list per washer with photo, time and location for every car, and a morning summary to you. Shall I get a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're free to say no.
